title: CWP/25385/2025 of DAKSHIN HARYANA BIJLI VITRAN NIGAM LIMITED Vs UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS
petitioner: Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited
text:
117 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP No.25385 of 2025 Date of Decision: 29.08.2025 Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited …..Petitioner. Versus Union of India and others .....Respondents. CORAM: HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE LISA GILL HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE MEENAKSHI I. MEHTA Present:- Mr. Sandeep Goyal, Advocate with Mr. Rishab Singla, Advocate and Ms. Urvi Khanna, Advocate for the appellant. Ms. Isha Janjua, Advocate for Mr. Ajay Kalra, Sr. Standing Counsel, CBIC for the respondents. LISA GILL, J.(Oral)

1. Learned counsel for parties, at the very outset, are ad-idem that controversy at hand is squarely covered by order dated 10.12.2024, passed by the Co-ordinate Bench in CWP No.18967 of 2020 (Tecnimont Spa India Project Office Vs. State of Punjab and another) and other connected matters and that petition be disposed of in the same terms. Reference is also made to subsequent orders dated 24.01.2025 and 05.03.2025, passed in CWP No.1399 of 2025 and CWP No.4977 of 2025, respectively, which were disposed of in terms of CWP No.18967 of 2020. authenticity of this order/judgment CWP No.25385 of 2025 -22. Keeping in view of facts and circumstances as above and specific stand of parties, this writ petition is disposed of in terms of order dated 10.12.2024 passed in CWP No.18967 of 2020 (Tecnimont Spa India Project Office Vs. State of Punjab and another). (LISA GILL) JUDGE (MEENAKSHI I. MEHTA) August 29, 2025 JUDGE Yag Dutt authenticity of this order/judgment
